title: Creeper Hearts
description:
What if Creepers spread love instead of destruction?
Creeper Hearts transforms every Creeper explosion into a burst of magical hearts that heal nearby players and restore their hunger instead of causing damage.
body:
💚 Creeper Hearts is a simple but fun Minecraft mod that gives Creepers a wholesome twist.

Instead of exploding and destroying everything around them, Creepers release a cloud of floating hearts that:

❤️ Restore player health
🍖 Refill hunger
💥 Cause no explosion damage
🌸 Create a friendly and peaceful effect

Perfect for casual survival, multiplayer servers, family-friendly gameplay, or anyone who wants Creepers to be helpful instead of terrifying.

Features:

❤️ Creeper explosions become healing heart bursts.
🍖 Restores both health and hunger.
💚 Safe for nearby players.
⚡ Lightweight and performance-friendly.
🎮 Works naturally in survival gameplay.

Turn Minecraft's most feared mob into your unexpected healer!
